parts.zh: M：今晚我们请来了一位来自本地巴黎咖啡馆的特别嘉宾
W：你好，谢谢你邀请我参加你的节目
M：感谢你加入我们。那么请告诉我们
W：嗯，我们看到了提供一些特别的
M：确实如此。那么你们的店有什么不同呢？
W：简单地说，我们店里有兔子自由走来走去
M：太神奇了！你们是怎么想到这个主意的？
W：我们看到过其他有猫咪的咖啡馆
M：但这样安全吗？兔子会不会咬人？或者有没有顾客伤害过兔子？
W：这对兔子和顾客双方来说都完全安全
M：嗯，我还是第一次听说有这样的咖啡馆

items.stem: What do we learn about the woman?

choices.text: She advocates animal protection.
choices.zh: 她倡导动物保护。

choices.text: She sells a special kind of coffee.
choices.zh: 她销售一种特殊的咖啡。

choices.text: She is going to start a café chain.
choices.zh: 她打算开一家连锁咖啡馆。

choices.text: She is the owner of a special café.
choices.zh: 她是一家特色咖啡馆的老板。

items.stem: What does the woman say about cafes in her city?

choices.text: They bear a lot of similarities.
choices.zh: 它们有很多相似之处。

choices.text: They are a profitable business sector.
choices.zh: 它们是一个盈利的商业部门。

choices.text: They cater to different customers.
choices.zh: 它们迎合不同的顾客。

choices.text: They help take care of customers' pets.
choices.zh: 它们帮助照顾顾客的宠物。

items.stem: How does the Parisian cafe guarantee that its rabbits pose no health threat?

choices.text: By giving them regular cleaning and injections.
choices.zh: 通过定期给它们清洁和注射疫苗。

choices.text: By selecting breeds that are tame and peaceful.
choices.zh: 通过选择温顺平和的品种。

choices.text: By placing them at a safe distance from customers.
choices.zh: 通过将它们放置在与顾客保持安全距离的地方。

choices.text: By briefing customers on how to get along with them.
choices.zh: 通过向顾客介绍如何与它们相处。

items.stem: What does the woman say about their customers?

choices.text: They want to learn about rabbits.
choices.zh: 他们想了解兔子。

choices.text: They like to bring in their children.
choices.zh: 他们喜欢带着孩子来。

choices.text: They love the animals in her café.
choices.zh: 他们喜爱她咖啡馆里的动物。

choices.text: They give her café favorite reviews.
choices.zh: 他们给她的咖啡馆好评。

items.stem: What do the speakers say about the food their children like?

choices.text: It contains too many additives.
choices.zh: 它含有太多添加剂。

choices.text: It lacks the essential vitamins.
choices.zh: 它缺乏必需的维生素。

choices.text: It can cause obesity.
choices.zh: 它会导致肥胖。

choices.text: It is mostly garbage.
choices.zh: 它大多是垃圾食品。

items.stem: According to the speakers, what affects children's choice of food most?

choices.text: Its fancy design.
choices.zh: 它花哨的设计。

choices.text: TV commercials.
choices.zh: 电视广告。

choices.text: Its taste and texture.
choices.zh: 它的味道和质地。

choices.text: Peer influence.
choices.zh: 同伴的影响。

items.stem: What do the speakers believe big food corporations are doing?

choices.text: Investing heavily in the production of sweet foods.
choices.zh: 在甜食生产上大量投资。

choices.text: Marketing their products with ordinary ingredients.
choices.zh: 用普通配料营销他们的产品。

choices.text: Trying to trick children into buying their products.
choices.zh: 试图诱骗孩子购买他们的产品。

choices.text: Offering children more varieties to choose from.
choices.zh: 为孩子提供更多可供选择的品种。

items.stem: What do we know about the speakers when they were children?

choices.text: They hardly ate vegetables.
choices.zh: 他们几乎不吃蔬菜。

choices.text: They seldom had junk food.
choices.zh: 他们很少吃垃圾食品。

choices.text: They favored chocolate-coated sweets.
choices.zh: 他们喜欢巧克力包裹的糖果。

choices.text: They liked the food advertised on TV.
choices.zh: 他们喜欢电视上做广告的食品。

items.stem: What can be found in the Valley of the Kings?

choices.text: Stretches of farmland.
choices.zh: 成片的农田。

choices.text: Typical Egyptian animal farms.
choices.zh: 典型的埃及动物农场。

choices.text: Tombs of ancient rulers.
choices.zh: 古代统治者的陵墓。

choices.text: Ruins left by devastating floods.
choices.zh: 毁灭性洪水留下的废墟。

items.stem: In what way is the Amazon different from other big rivers?

choices.text: It provides habitats for more primitive tribes.
choices.zh: 它为更多原始部落提供栖息地。

choices.text: It is hardly associated with great civilizations.
choices.zh: 它几乎不与伟大文明相关联。

choices.text: It has not yet been fully explored and exploited.
choices.zh: 它尚未被完全勘探和开发。

choices.text: It gathers water from many tropical rain forests.
choices.zh: 它从许多热带雨林汇集水源。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the Amazon?

choices.text: It carries about one fifth of the world's fresh water.
choices.zh: 它携带着世界上约五分之一的淡水。

choices.text: It has numerous human settlements along its banks.
choices.zh: 它的两岸有众多人类定居点。

choices.text: It is second only to the Mississippi River in width.
choices.zh: 它的宽度仅次于密西西比河。

choices.text: It is as long as the Nile and the Yangtze combined.
choices.zh: 它的长度相当于尼罗河和长江加起来的长度。

items.stem: What does the speaker think is an inevitable truth?

choices.text: Living a life in the fast lane leads to success.
choices.zh: 快节奏的生活方式会带来成功。

choices.text: We are always in a rush to do various things.
choices.zh: 我们总是匆匆忙忙地做各种事情。

choices.text: The search for tranquility has become a trend.
choices.zh: 对宁静的追求已经成为一种趋势。

choices.text: All of us actually yearn for a slow and calm life.
choices.zh: 我们所有人实际上都渴望缓慢而平静的生活。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about her life in Tokyo?

choices.text: She had trouble balancing family and work.
choices.zh: 她在平衡家庭和工作方面遇到了困难。

choices.text: She enjoyed the various social events.
choices.zh: 她喜欢各种社交活动。

choices.text: She was accustomed to tight schedules.
choices.zh: 她习惯于紧凑的日程安排。

choices.text: She spent all her leisure time writing books.
choices.zh: 她把所有闲暇时间都用来写书。

items.stem: What made the speaker change her lifestyle?

choices.text: The possibility of ruining her family.
choices.zh: 可能毁掉她的家庭。

choices.text: Becoming aware of her declining health.
choices.zh: 意识到自己的健康状况在下降。

choices.text: The fatigue from living a fast-paced life.
choices.zh: 快节奏生活带来的疲惫。

choices.text: Reading a book about slowing down.
choices.zh: 读了一本关于放慢生活节奏的书。

items.stem: What happened after the speaker changed her lifestyle?

choices.text: She started to follow the cultural norms.
choices.zh: 她开始遵循文化规范。

choices.text: She came to enjoy doing everyday tasks.
choices.zh: 她开始享受做日常事务。

choices.text: She learned to use more polite expressions.
choices.zh: 她学会了使用更礼貌的表达方式。

choices.text: She stopped using to-do lists and calendars.
choices.zh: 她不再使用待办事项清单和日历。

items.stem: What assumption about introduced species is challenged by a number of scientists?

choices.text: They will root out native species altogether.
choices.zh: 它们会彻底根除本地物种。

choices.text: They contribute to a region's biodiversity.
choices.zh: 它们有助于地区生物多样性。

choices.text: They pose a threat to the local ecosystem.
choices.zh: 它们对当地生态系统构成威胁。

choices.text: They will crossbreed with native species.
choices.zh: 它们会与本地物种杂交。

items.stem: What does Dr. Michael Rosenzweig think of exotic and native species?

choices.text: Their classifications are meaningful.
choices.zh: 它们的分类是有意义的。

choices.text: Their interactions are hard to define.
choices.zh: 它们的相互作用难以界定。

choices.text: Their definitions are changeable.
choices.zh: 它们的定义是可变的。

choices.text: Their distinctions are artificial.
choices.zh: 它们的区别是人为的。

items.stem: What does Professor Don Smith say about alien species?

choices.text: Only a few of them cause problems to native species.
choices.zh: 它们中只有少数对本地物种造成问题。

choices.text: They may turn out to benefit the local environment.
choices.zh: 它们可能最终对当地环境有益。

choices.text: Few of them can survive in their new habitats.
choices.zh: 它们中很少能在新栖息地存活。

choices.text: Only 10 percent of them can be naturalized.
choices.zh: 它们中只有百分之十能够归化。

items.stem: What should you do when doing business with foreigners?

choices.text: Respect their traditional culture.
choices.zh: 尊重他们的传统文化。

choices.text: Attend their business seminars.
choices.zh: 参加他们的商务研讨会。

choices.text: Research their specific demands.
choices.zh: 研究他们的具体需求。

choices.text: Adopt the right business strategies.
choices.zh: 采用正确的商业策略。

items.stem: What must you avoid doing with your Indian colleague?

choices.text: Showing them your palm.
choices.zh: 向他们展示你的手掌。

choices.text: Giving them gifts of great value.
choices.zh: 赠送他们贵重的礼物。

choices.text: Drinking alcohol on certain days of a month.
choices.zh: 在一个月中的某些日子饮酒。

choices.text: Clicking your fingers loudly in their presence.
choices.zh: 在他们面前大声打响指。

items.stem: What do we learn about some Spanish business people?

choices.text: They are very easy to satisfy.
choices.zh: 他们很容易满足。

choices.text: They have a strong sense of worth.
choices.zh: 他们有很强的自我价值感。

choices.text: They tend to be friendly and enthusiastic.
choices.zh: 他们往往友好而热情。

choices.text: They have a break from 2:00 to 5:30 p.m.
choices.zh: 他们下午2点到5点半休息。

items.stem: What did George Grune do in 1984?

choices.text: He completely changed the company's culture.
choices.zh: 他彻底改变了公司的文化。

choices.text: He collected paintings by world-famous artists.
choices.zh: 他收藏了世界著名艺术家的画作。

choices.text: He took over the sales department of Reader's Digest.
choices.zh: 他接管了Reader's Digest的销售部门。

choices.text: He had the company's boardroom extensively renovated.
choices.zh: 他对公司的董事会议室进行了大规模翻新。

items.stem: How did the Wallaces define the formula for Reader's Digest?

choices.text: It should be sold at a reasonable price.
choices.zh: 它应该以合理的价格出售。

choices.text: Its articles should be short and inspiring.
choices.zh: 它的文章应该简短而鼓舞人心。

choices.text: It should be published in the world's leading languages.
choices.zh: 它应该以世界主要语言出版。

choices.text: Its articles should entertain blue- and pink-collar workers.
choices.zh: 它的文章应该娱乐蓝领和粉领工人。

items.stem: What do we learn about the founder of Reader's Digest, DeWitt Wallace?

choices.text: He knew how to make the magazine profitable.
choices.zh: 他知道如何让杂志盈利。

choices.text: He served as a church minister for many years.
choices.zh: 他担任教会牧师多年。

choices.text: He suffered many setbacks and misfortunes in his life.
choices.zh: 他一生中经历了许多挫折和不幸。

choices.text: He treated the employees like members of his family.
choices.zh: 他像对待家人一样对待员工。

items.stem: What change took place in Reader's Digest after the Wallaces' death?

choices.text: It carried many more advertisements.
choices.zh: 它刊登了更多的广告。

choices.text: George Grune joined it as an ad salesman.
choices.zh: George Grune作为广告销售员加入了它。

choices.text: Several hundred of its employees got fired.
choices.zh: 数百名员工被解雇。

choices.text: Its subscriptions increased considerably.
choices.zh: 它的订阅量大幅增加。
